title: Competitor Evaluation Tracking for B2B Teams
summary: Find out which accounts are evaluating your competitors. Letterdrop flags in-market accounts with a confidence score and routes them to your reps daily.
body_markdown:
If a target account is actively evaluating your competitor right now, you want to know before the deal closes. Competitor sales activity tracking gives your revenue team early visibility into live competitive evaluations, so your reps can reach the buyer while they are still forming their opinion — not after they have already signed.


Letterdrop flags accounts likely evaluating a competitor and suggests who on the buying team to contact, so your reps can act immediately. Updated daily, with no guesswork and no cold starts.


## How Competitor Sales Activity Tracking Works


You do not have access to your competitor's CRM. But you can still spot the accounts evaluating them. Letterdrop identifies accounts showing signs of an active evaluation with your competitors and flags each one with a confidence score, at roughly 70% accuracy.


Think of it as a read on your competitor's pipeline. You do not see their pipeline stages or opportunity values. But you do see which accounts are likely evaluating them. And that is often all you need to know who to call today.


## What Letterdrop Delivers for Each Competitive Signal


When Letterdrop flags an account as likely evaluating a competitor, it routes that account to the right rep in your CRM or Slack. Each alert includes the company, a confidence score, suggested contacts on the buying team, and a suggested outreach message your rep can approve and send. Reps have what they need to personalize the first touch without additional research.


## Why Timing Is Everything in Competitive Interception


A buyer in the early stages of evaluating a competitor can still be influenced. They have not decided yet. A rep who reaches them at this stage with a credible, relevant message can shape how the buyer thinks about the evaluation criteria, what they expect from a solution, and why your approach is different. A rep who finds out after the deal closes has no influence at all.


Letterdrop updates competitive signals daily. Reps receive fresh opportunities every morning so the window to intercept a deal never closes without their knowledge.


## Real Results From Letterdrop Customers


One Letterdrop customer booked 4 deals and $200k in pipeline in a single 3-week sprint using competitor monitoring signals. Another identified 3 customers who were churning to competitors within 3 weeks and intervened before the switch was complete. A third customer booked meetings with 75% of their dream accounts by acting on Letterdrop's competitor signals.


## How to Set Up Competitor Monitoring in Letterdrop


Setup is straightforward. You tell Letterdrop which competitors matter to your business. Letterdrop flags accounts across your target account list and ICP that show signs of evaluating those competitors. In-market accounts, suggested contacts, and recommended next actions are routed to your CRM or Slack daily. No manual research, no stale data.


## Frequently Asked Questions


**How accurate is Letterdrop's competitor evaluation detection?** Letterdrop flags accounts likely evaluating a competitor with roughly 70% accuracy, and every flag carries a confidence score. False positives exist, which is why every lead includes context for the rep to evaluate before reaching out.


**Which competitors can I add?** You can define any number of competitors relevant to your business. Letterdrop flags accounts across your ICP that show signs of evaluating those specific competitors.


**Can I use this for customer retention, not just new business?** Yes. Letterdrop can flag existing accounts that show signs of evaluating a competitive replacement, giving your CS team early warning to intervene.
